mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, which increases the risk of stagflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5pp in 2 months AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 260.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 545,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market recovery, which increases consumer spending and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month AND UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
